config.label: Reachable self-hosted or replacement hosted Huly API URL
config.description: Reachable self-hosted or replacement hosted Huly API URL

config.label: Connection timeout in milliseconds
config.description: Connection timeout in milliseconds. Omit to use the package default.

config.label: Tool exposure mode: auto (default), native, or proxy
config.description: Tool exposure mode: auto (default), native, or proxy. Auto keeps exact claude-code native and resolves Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, Copilot, opencode, Claude AI, and unknown clients to proxy mode.

config.label: Set true to make active TOOLSETS / TOOLS a hard allow-list for proxy search, schema lookup, and invocation
config.description: Set true to make active TOOLSETS / TOOLS a hard allow-list for proxy search, schema lookup, and invocation. Defaults to false.

config.label: Comma-separated native Huly tool categories to expose, such as issues,projects,search
config.description: Comma-separated native Huly tool categories to expose, such as issues,projects,search. If unset with TOOLS, all native tools are exposed.

config.label: Comma-separated exact native Huly tool names to expose in addition to selected TOOLSETS, such as list_documents,create_issue
config.description: Comma-separated exact native Huly tool names to expose in addition to selected TOOLSETS, such as list_documents,create_issue.
